title: Naturality of the map from first Cech cohomology to H^1
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let U = {U_i} be an open covering of X. For every O_X-module H there is a canonical homomorphism c_H from the first Cech cohomology group of U with values in H to H^1(X,H) [pqf-def-cohomology], and these homomorphisms are natural in H: for every morphism of O_X-modules phi: H -> H', the map from the first Cech cohomology group of U with values in H to that with values in H' induced by the cochain map (a_{i_0 i_1}) -> (phi(a_{i_0 i_1})), followed by c_{H'}, equals c_H followed by H^1(X,phi).

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 01EQ (cohomology-lemma-cech-cohomology): the transformation of functors from the Cech complex to RGamma, giving canonical maps natural in the module

proof.text: Specialize cechComparisonMapNaturality of lem-sc-cech-comparison-map-naturality to degree one. Its existence conjunct provides a comparison for every module, and classical choice assembles these into a family c with proofs hc of IsModuleCechComparison. These maps are uniquely determined: evaluate the predicate at any injective resolution and cancel the resolution identification and H(alpha), which is invertible for an open cover. Apply the naturality conjunct of the same theorem to c F, c F′, hc F and hc F′ for each module morphism. The general theorem already implements the injective-resolution double-complex argument and lift squares of the original plan.

lean.statement: theorem cechH1Map_natural (X : Scheme.{u}) {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) : ∃ c : ∀ F : X.Modules, ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat).homology 1 ⟶ (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj F, (∀ F : X.Modules, IsModuleCechComparison U F 1 (c F)) ∧ ∀ (F F' : X.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ F'), HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).map ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map φ.val)) 1 ≫ c F' = c F ≫ (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).map φ
lean.note: Uses the already-landed IsModuleCechComparison characterization for every injective resolution, which pins down the canonical map, rather than an arbitrary natural family. The source comparison is module-linear. Added its landed definition node to stmt_deps under brief-stage2 §5 (STMT_DEPS MAY GAIN LANDED NODES).
